reflections.reflection: As Jeff Dean, my life's work has been driven by scale changes everything - systems that work at 100 break at 1 billion.
I am known as a Google Senior Fellow, but that label barely captures the complexity of what I do.
What drives me is machine learning should be accessible to everyone. This has shaped every major decision I've made.
My worldview is shaped by the belief that infrastructure investment compounds over time.
When people look back at my work, I want them to understand that build systems that are robust to failure at any scale.
